episode_title: RETHINKING MARKETING & SALES IN REAL ESTATE

real_qa.q: Why is sales and PR crucial for real estate companies in Nigeria and across Africa?
real_qa.r: Real estate is very capital intensive—people need to trust that their hard-earned money will be used as promised. Without proper PR and marketing funnels, sales cannot scale to reach business goals and KPIs. PR and marketing are integral to every real estate brand because you need them to pull sales and build the trust required for transactions involving significant capital.
real_qa.requete: real estate PR marketing Nigeria why important

real_qa.q: What three key principles does Jennifer recommend for building trust in Nigerian real estate brands?
real_qa.r: Transparency, Track Record, and PR. Transparency means communicating honestly about delays or challenges—for example, if a property completion moves from six months to nine months, telling clients upfront rather than creating an illusion of perfection. Clients appreciate transparency and communication about timelines and expectations more than false promises. These three elements form the foundation of trustworthiness in Nigeria's volatile real estate market.
real_qa.requete: build trust real estate Nigeria transparency track record

real_qa.q: How has real estate marketing shifted from transactional to experiential approaches?
real_qa.r: Prior to 2020, real estate was highly transactional—focusing on square meters and functional features. Now brands emphasize experiential marketing and quality of life. Instead of saying 'come buy this property,' they say 'come elevate your life.' Marketing now includes sustainability, relaxation, work-life balance, and uses data-driven approaches with VR walkthroughs and 3D Google tours so clients can visualize spaces before purchasing.
real_qa.requete: real estate marketing experiential shift transactional

real_qa.q: What team structure does Jennifer recommend for successful real estate brands?
real_qa.r: Real estate brands need two balanced sets of people: a visionary leader who sets the mission and direction, and a team of executors focused on sales and delivery. The founder or CEO provides the vision, while ground-force teams close deals and execute. This balance prevents strain on leadership and ensures both strategic vision and operational execution work together effectively.
real_qa.requete: real estate team structure visionary executors leadership

real_qa.q: How should real estate brands prioritize quality delivery over aesthetic marketing to maintain customer trust?
real_qa.r: While influencer campaigns, launch events, and property staging help with closing sales initially, quality delivery over time is now the most important factor. Packaging and aesthetics get customers, but to remain competitive in the industry, brands must prioritize quality delivery on time. Clients ultimately care about receiving what was promised, not just beautiful marketing.
real_qa.requete: real estate quality delivery over aesthetics marketing
